CustomField.description: Routes the mandate to the FAB legacy path or the UAEDDS path. Defaults to UAEDDS: every new mandate takes the new path regardless of which surface created it. All pre-existing records were backfilled to FAB Legacy on 2026-08-23 before this default was applied.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: FAB Legacy for mandates raised before UAEDDS. UAEDDS for all new mandates.
CustomField.label: Gateway
